sentences.en: Willingness to take responsibility is a sign of maturity.
sentences.zh: 愿意承担责任是成熟的标志。

sentences.en: The impairment cannot bring them to lose their willingness to live.
sentences.zh: 这种障碍不能让他们失去生活的意愿。

sentences.en: I admire your willingness to help people in need.
sentences.zh: 我赞赏你帮助需要帮助的人的意愿。

senses.zh: 乐意；心甘情愿；自动自发
